headline: Whipsaw environment. The best trade tonight may be no trade.
trading_action_detail: The breadth is telling you this is a whipsaw environment. Qullamaggie: 'You know, you do half size in a market that's bad and you do it 10 times, it kinda adds up. That's always been my problem... overtrading.' Don't scan for new longs tonight. Review your open positions. Tighten stops. Let the market resolve before adding exposure.
scan_guidance:
⚠️  SCAN CAUTIOUSLY — CHOP ENVIRONMENT
The breadth is in a whipsaw zone. If you scan, be very selective:
  • Only stocks with ADR% > 5% (need extra volatility to overcome chop)
  • Dollar Volume > $50M (liquidity is critical in chop)
  • Only the tightest consolidations — 3-5% range over 2+ weeks
  • Avoid extended stocks — chop will punish chasing
  • Reduce position size by 50% vs your normal size
  • Consider skipping entirely and waiting for regime to clarify
key_signals: Quarter breadth: 1531 stocks up 25%+ — Broad participation (3d: -95, contracting)
⚠️  Down quarter breadth: 950 stocks down 25%+ — Damage accumulating under the surface (3d chg: +106)
⚠️  EUPHORIA: 104 stocks up 50%+ this month — Late stage. Tighten stops on existing positions.
〰️  Chop signals: High two-way action (351 up / 404 dn) | T2108 in mid-zone (52.7%)

breakdown.label: Very strong intermediate trend — hold longs longer

action_items: Review your open positions and tighten stops where needed
Build your watchlist for when conditions improve
Read the Watch For section — know what signal you're waiting for
Check the MM page tomorrow morning before the open
watch_for: 5-day ratio breaking decisively above 1.3 = chop is ending, prepare to scan
5-day ratio breaking below 0.85 = chop resolving to the downside, go defensive
T2108 moving out of the 40-65% band = regime change coming
Two-way action (Up4+Down4) declining = conviction returning to one side
coach_note:
The breadth is in a whipsaw environment. This is where most swing traders give back their gains. Qullamaggie: 'When there is not much to do in the markets, you get more time to study. Study setups, study traders, study the market, use it to your advantage.'
Brad Gilbert: 'Stop giving away free points.' In chop, every new long is a potential free point given away.
Paul Annacone coached Federer to recognize when the conditions weren't right for his game and adjust. This is your adjustment day.
mental_anchor: In chop, sitting out IS the trade. Protect your capital. The trending market will return.
mental_reset:
Take a breath. The market is choppy — and that's actually useful information.
Breathe in — 4. Hold — 2. Out — 6.
Recognize: you are not missing out by sitting out. You are PROTECTING your capital.
The traders who survive long enough to trade the next bull market are the ones who didn't blow up in the chop.
Tonight: review your positions, tighten stops, and prepare your watchlist.
trend_stage_detail: LATE BULL — Trend is aging. Freshness ratio at 0.19 (below 0.25) means fewer new stocks are joining the move — the same leaders are carrying the index. Euphoria at 0.35 — 104 stocks are up 50%+ in a month, which means leaders are getting extended and parabolic. Qullamaggie: 'When everything has already moved, the easy money is gone.' Be very selective. Only the tightest, freshest bases. Tighten stops on existing winners.
scan_quality_detail: Monthly momentum at 3.0x. Good scan environment. Focus on stocks that have moved 15-25%+ in the last month and are consolidating. Look for tight, orderly bases — the kind where the stock is 'resting' not 'breaking down'. ADR% > 3.5%, Dollar Vol > $25M. Be patient with entries — wait for the pivot. WARNING: Damage ratio at 0.62 — 950 stocks are down 25%+ this quarter even as leaders run. This is a bifurcated market. Stock selection is critical. One bad pick in this environment can wipe out 3 good trades. Stick to the leaders.
